strings.info: This factor allows for NOT being an administrator to count as a factor. Its intended use is to ensure administators require tighter security, so regular users get the weight for free, while admins must use other factors.
strings.privacy:metadata: The Non-administrator factor plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.settings:description: All users except site administrators receive the points for this factor. This allows you to require additional authentication factors for site administrators.
strings.settings:shortdescription: Require additional authentication factors for administrators.
strings.settings:weight_help: Weight is given to regular users for this factor, so admins must have more factors than a regular user to pass.
